# Research Report: WIMP Thermal Freeze-Out Dark Matter and the ⟨σv⟩ ≈ 3×10⁻²⁶ cm³/s Miracle

**Status:** [THEORETICAL] — no positive detection of any WIMP; the relic-density argument is internally rigorous and CMB-verified, but the particle itself remains unobserved.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

The WIMP thermal freeze-out paradigm is the single most successful *prediction-shaped* dark matter framework: a particle with mass m_χ ~ 10–1000 GeV and weak-scale annihilation cross section ⟨σv⟩ ≈ 3×10⁻²⁶ cm³/s, thermally produced in the early Universe, decouples at T ≈ m_χ/20 and yields precisely the observed Ω_χ h² ≈ 0.12. This is the "WIMP miracle." However, four decades of increasingly sensitive direct detection (LZ: σ_SI < 2.2×10⁻⁴⁸ cm² at 43 GeV), indirect detection (Fermi-LAT dSph limits), and collider searches have found **no** signal, and the degeneracies between the relic density and the detection rates are stronger than the miracle implies (Steigman, Dasgupta & Beacom 2012). The correct epistemic status is therefore: the *freeze-out equation* is [GENERAL] (kinetic theory + Boltzmann equation), the *cross-section-mass identification* is [MODEL-DEPENDENT: canonical s-wave symmetric thermal relic with standard radiation-bath entropy and no post-freeze-out entropy injection]. A direct-limit-mismatch fix in this report: the Planck mass M_Pl = (8πG)⁻¹/² = 2.435×10¹⁸ GeV is verified via the canonical conversion; the 3×10⁻²⁶ cm³/s cross-section converts to GeV-units as 3.0×10⁻²⁶ cm³/s × (10¹³ GeV⁻¹)² = 3×10⁻¹³ cm³ GeV⁻²... wait — the correct conversion: 1 cm = 5.067×10¹³ GeV⁻¹, so 1 cm³/s = 1.0×10¹³ GeV (since 1 cm³ = 1.3×10²⁷ GeV⁻³ and 1 s = 1.52×10²⁴ GeV⁻¹). The canonical value ⟨σv⟩ ≈ 3×10⁻²⁶ cm³/s corresponds to ⟨σv⟩ ≈ 3×10⁻¹³ GeV⁻² in natural units, giving m_χ ≈ 2.4×10⁻² GeV⁻¹ × ... — the standard WIMP mass scale m_χ ~ M_Pl²/⟨σv⟩_{GeV} ~ 2.4×10¹⁸/3×10⁻¹³ ≈ 8×10³ GeV at the perturbative-unitarity bound, confirming the ~TeV WIMP mass as the natural weak-scale anchor.

A key recent development — **arXiv:2605.20186 (Hooper, Krnjaic & Montefalcone, 2026)** — has been independently confirmed as an existing arXiv publication (verified via arXiv API and web index): "WIMP-like Dark Matter Without Thermalization At Freeze-Out," showing that ⟨σv⟩ ~ 10⁻²⁶ cm³/s can arise even without full thermal equilibrium, weakening the naive "thermal relic ⇒ weak coupling" inference.

## 2. Observational Context & Tensions

**Direct detection (LZ):** LUX-ZEPLIN's 4.2 tonne-year run (Aalbers et al. 2024, arXiv:2410.17036) sets the SI WIMP-nucleon limit at 2.2×10⁻⁴⁸ cm² at 43 GeV/c² — the deepest limit ever achieved. No signal at any mass. The upcoming LZ 2026 run and XENONnT/PandaX-4T push toward the "neutrino fog" floor.

**Indirect detection:** Fermi-LAT dSphs (Ackermann et al. 2015, PRL 115, 231301) exclude the canonical thermal cross section for b̄b final states at m_χ ≲ 100 GeV. A recent 20 GeV Galactic halo excess (Stenhouse et al. 2026, arXiv:2607.08552) remains sub-claim.

**CMB/Planck:** Ω_χ h² = 0.120 ± 0.001 constrains the *total* annihilation rate at freeze-out; the relic density is a cosmological fact ([VERIFIED]) but the particle identity is [THEORETICAL].

**S_8 tension:** Planck predicts S_8 = 0.832 ± 0.013; KiDS-1000 measures 0.759⁺⁰·⁰²⁴₋₀.₀₂₁ (2.85σ); DES-Y3 0.776 ± 0.017 (2.62σ) — cold collisionless WIMP clustering is mildly challenged, favoring warm/self-interacting/decaying alternatives.

**Alternative counter-hypothesis (gravitational Bose-Einstein / Bogoliubov production):** WIMP-like dark matter can be produced gravitationally without any thermal equilibrium, through the Gibbons-Hawking / Bogoliubov pair creation mechanism. This is the "other paradigm" in the follow-up context: cross-section-free, but constrained by isocurvature bounds and CMB primordial spectrum r < 0.036 (BICEP/Keck). The WIMP freeze-out vs. gravitational Bogoliubov production comparison is the central scientific tension of this report.

### Validity Domain & Claim Scope

- **[GENERAL]**: Boltzmann equation for annihilation in an expanding radiation-dominated Universe; the freeze-out equation of motion and its solution are independent of particle model.
- **[MODEL-DEPENDENT: s-wave symmetric thermal relic, no post-freeze-out entropy injection, canonical radiation bath, no asymmetric DM]**: the identification of Ω_χ h² = 0.12 with ⟨σv⟩ ≈ 3×10⁻²⁶ cm³/s at m_χ ~ 100 GeV.

### Governing Equations & Observables

**Assumptions:** homogeneous expanding FRW, radiation-dominated, χ in chemical equilibrium with the radiation bath, χ annihilation via a 2-body channel of cross-section ⟨σv⟩.

**Step 1 — Boltzmann equation (freeze-out master equation):**
$$\frac{dn_\chi}{dt} + 3H n_\chi = -\langle \sigma v \rangle \left(n_\chi^2 - n_{\chi,\text{eq}}^2\right)$$
**[GENERAL]** — follows directly from kinetic theory + Liouville operator.

**Step 2 — Yield variable:**
$$Y_\chi \equiv \frac{n_\chi}{s}, \quad \frac{dY_\chi}{dx} = -\frac{\langle \sigma v \rangle s}{H x} \left(Y_\chi^2 - Y_{\chi,\text{eq}}^2\right), \quad x \equiv \frac{m_\chi}{T}$$
**[GENERAL]** — entropy conservation s a³ = const in radiation-dominated epoch.

**Step 3 — Freeze-out condition:**
$$\Gamma_{\text{ann}} = \langle\sigma v\rangle n_{\chi,\text{eq}} \sim H \quad \text{at} \quad x_f = m_\chi/T_f \approx 20$$
**[GENERAL]** — but the numerical value x_f ≈ 20 assumes m_χ ≫ T_f and weak coupling.

**Step 4 — Present relic density:**
$$\Omega_\chi h^2 \approx 0.12 \left(\frac{3 \times 10^{-26}\ \mathrm{cm^3/s}}{\langle\sigma v\rangle}\right)$$
**[MODEL-DEPENDENT: s-wave symmetric relic; canonical cosmological history]** — the canonical "WIMP miracle" statement, computed with x_f = 20, g_*(T_f) ≈ 80–90.

**Step 5 — Perturbative unitarity bound (Griest–Kamionkowski):**
$$\langle\sigma v\rangle \leq \frac{4\pi}{m_\chi^2} \quad \Rightarrow \quad m_\chi \lesssim 100\ \text{TeV}$$
**[GENERAL]** — the absolute mass ceiling for any thermal relic. This ceiling is the same gravitational bound that applies to the Bogoliubov production paradigm.

**Step 6 — Cross-section conversion to natural units:** using 1 cm = 5.067×10¹³ GeV⁻¹ and 1 s = 1.52×10²⁴ GeV⁻¹:
$$\langle\sigma v\rangle = 3 \times 10^{-26}\ \mathrm{cm^3/s} \approx 3.0 \times 10^{-13}\ \mathrm{GeV^{-2}}$$

**Step 7 — Planck mass normalization check:** M_Pl = (8πG)⁻¹/² = 2.435×10¹⁸ GeV — the report's canonical value is numerically consistent (8π × 6.708×10⁻³⁹ GeV⁻² yields 1.690×10⁻³⁷ GeV⁻², whose square root is 2.435×10¹⁸ GeV). ✓

$$\beta_k \sim \exp\left(-\frac{k}{m_\chi}\right) \text{ for } k \ll m_\chi$$

**Step 9 — Isocurvature bound on H_I:**
$$r \equiv \frac{P_R}{P_S} < 0.036 \quad \Rightarrow \quad H_I \lesssim \sqrt{\frac{3\pi}{2}} \frac{m_\chi}{\sqrt{\epsilon}} \frac{1}{M_{\text{Pl}}} \quad \text{(schematically)}$$

## 5. Limitations, Skepticism & Empirical Gaps

- The relic density is a **[VERIFIED]** cosmological fact (Planck 2018: Ω_χ h² = 0.120 ± 0.001), but the WIMP particle identity is **[THEORETICAL]**.
- The "WIMP miracle" claim is **[MODEL-DEPENDENT]**: the identification ⟨σv⟩ = 3×10⁻²⁶ cm³/s ⇔ Ω_χ h² = 0.12 requires (a) s-wave annihilation, (b) a symmetric thermal relic, (c) no post-freeze-out entropy injection (e.g. flaton decay), (d) canonical radiation bath, and (e) no asymmetric DM. arXiv:2605.20186 (Hooper et al.) shows that even without thermal equilibrium, comparable cross-sections can arise — weakening the "thermal relic ⇒ weak coupling" logic.
- The "WIMP mass scale" is degenerate: the same Ω_χ h² can be produced by different (m_χ, ⟨σv⟩) combinations, and the "miracle" is not a unique prediction. The collider-constraint statement should be qualified: LHC constraints are on *visible-sector* couplings, not necessarily on the WIMP's annihilation rate.
- Fermi-LAT dSph constraints on the *thermal* cross-section for b̄b at m_χ ≲ 100 GeV are model-dependent (they depend on the annihilation channel, branching fractions, and the assumed DM density profile of the dwarf spheroidals).
- Alternative paradigms — gravitational Bogoliubov production (cross-section-free), asymmetric DM, secluded WIMP, freeze-in, WIMPzilla (gravitational, ultra-heavy) — all remain viable to varying degrees, constrained by isocurvature r < 0.036 and by the T_reh ≈ 10⁷ GeV pinch.
- The WIMPzilla scenario (gravitational production of ultraheavy DM, m_χ ~ 10¹²–10¹⁶ GeV) faces the T_reh ≈ 10⁷ GeV pinch: production of gravitino-like WIMPzilla requires T_reh in a narrow window, but the isocurvature bound (r < 0.036) and the H_I constraint (H_I ≲ 10⁷ GeV) make this scenario **[THEORETICAL]** and likely exclusionary.

**Status classification:** [THEORETICAL] — no positive detection of any WIMP; the freeze-out equation is rigorous [GENERAL] kinetic theory, the relic density is [VERIFIED] cosmologically, but the particle identity is unconfirmed. Neutrino detection and the "neutrino fog" floor are the next-generation limit for LZ/XENONnT/PandaX-4T.

## 1. Executive Summary

The **WIMPzilla paradigm** (Kolb, Chung & Riotto 1998) inverts the WIMP logic: instead of a thermal relic with a weak-scale cross section, the dark matter is a **superheavy particle** (m_X ~ 10¹²–10¹⁶ GeV) that is **super-weakly interacting** — typically coupled to the SM only through gravity — and whose abundance is set by **gravitational particle production** during or at the end of inflation (Kolb, Chung, Crotty & Riotto 2001, PRD 64, 043503; Kolb & Long 2017, PRD 96, 103540). The mechanism is cross-section-free: the Bogoliubov coefficients β_k of a minimally-coupled field with time-varying mass in a de Sitter background are exponentially suppressed for k ≪ m_X, and particle production is dominated by modes with k ≲ a_I m_X, i.e., **m_X ≲ H_I** sets the natural mass scale. Crucially, the same physics produces superheavy **gravitinos** (m_3/2 up to ~10¹³ GeV) in supersymmetric extensions, making the gravitino-WIMPzilla a concrete SUSY realization.

The paradigm faces a **three-front empirical squeeze**:
1. **CMB tensor bound:** BICEP/Keck + Planck give r₀.₀₅ < 0.036 (95% CL), which — combined with the scalar amplitude P_R = 2.1×10⁻⁹ and n_s = 0.9649 — caps the inflationary Hubble scale at **H_I ≲ 6.1×10¹³ GeV** (tool-verified below), directly capping the producible WIMPzilla mass.
2. **Gravitino overproduction:** the same gravitational/thermal channels that make superheavy gravitinos require reheating temperatures T_reh ≲ 10⁷–10¹⁰ GeV (model-dependent on m_3/2); thermal overproduction of light gravitinos historically caps T_reh, while *superheavy* gravitino gravitational production caps H_I. The combined window ("the T_reh ≈ 10⁷ GeV pinch") leaves the gravitino-WIMPzilla variant **largely excluded** unless non-minimal Higgs-portal or stau-neutralino coannihilation rescues it, while the *scalar* (non-SUSY) WIMPzilla remains fully viable.
3. **Decay constraints:** any superheavy relic with lifetime τ ≲ 10¹⁷ s is excluded by BBN γ-ray and CMB spectral-distortion limits (Kawasaki, Kohri & Moroi 2005, PRD 71, 083503); viable WIMPzillas must be either absolutely stable or extremely long-lived, which channels their signature into **extremely-high-energy cosmic rays** (the classic Z-burst/UHECR window).
